alt: Timeline of the early Church: Pentecost about 30 CE, Paul's journeys in the mid-first century, Nero blames Christians for the fire of Rome in 64 CE, Diocletian's persecution from 303, the Edict of Milan in 313, the Council of Nicaea in 325 and Christianity as the Empire's religion in 380-381.
caption: Figure: key dates in the early Church, from Pentecost to 381 CE (not to scale)

alt: Six types of family and who belongs to each: nuclear (two parents and children), extended (parents, children and other relatives), single-parent, child-headed, blended (two families joined by remarriage) and polygamous (one husband with more than one wife).
caption: Figure: the six types of family and who belongs to each

alt: The Five Pillars of Islam in outline: Shahadah, declaring faith in one God and in Muhammad as God's messenger; Salah, praying five times a day; Zakat, giving a fixed share of wealth to those in need; Sawm, fasting in Ramadan; Hajj, pilgrimage to Makkah once in a lifetime for those able.
caption: Figure: the Five Pillars of Islam in outline

alt: Stages of funeral and burial customs in Indigenous Religion: announcement, preparing the body, wake, burial, purification and mourning, followed often about a year later by kurova guva or umbuyiso, when the spirit is received as an ancestor; practices vary between peoples and families.
caption: Figure: funeral stages and the later kurova guva / umbuyiso (practices vary)

alt: The last week of Jesus in order: entry into Jerusalem (Mark 11:1-11), the Last Supper (Mark 14:22-25), Gethsemane and arrest, the trial before the Sanhedrin and Pilate, crucifixion at Golgotha, and on the third day the empty tomb (Mark 16:1-8).
caption: Figure: the events of the last week of Jesus in the Gospels, in order

alt: Timeline of Jewish history in order: early monarchy under Saul, David and Solomon, the divided kingdom, 586 BCE destruction of Jerusalem and the exile, the Second Temple, 70 CE destruction by the Romans, the diaspora, 1941-45 the Holocaust and 14 May 1948 the State of Israel.
caption: Figure: key events in Jewish history from the early monarchy to 1948 (not to scale)

alt: Main steps of the marriage process in Indigenous Religion in order: courtship, go-between, introduction, bride wealth (roora or lobola), advice from the bride's paternal aunt and uncles, and welcoming the bride at the groom's home; details differ between families and peoples.
caption: Figure: the main steps in the marriage process (details differ between families)

alt: Timeline of the four rightly guided caliphs, drawn to scale: Abu Bakr 632-634, Umar 634-644, Uthman 644-656 and Ali 656-661 CE, after which power passed to the Umayyad family ruling from Damascus.
caption: Figure: the four rightly guided caliphs, drawn to scale (approximate years CE)
